title: night_server

character.name: Тимур
character.design: young man about twenty two, wiry build, pale face with sharp cheekbones, messy black hair falling over the eyes, thin silver hoop in the left ear, wears an oversized black hoodie with a faded print, grey cargo pants, worn black sneakers, a thin chain around the neck

world: from a dim regional internet cafe in the late 2000s to a modern esports arena

shots.narration: в две тысячи девятом он играл в подвальном компьютерном клубе
shots.visual: dim basement internet cafe at night, rows of bulky CRT monitors, the character in the back row hunched over a scratched keyboard, cigarette smoke in the cold blue light, other players silhouetted around him
shots.motion: slow push-in from behind the row of monitors, screen glow flickering, smoke drifting
shots.brand_surface: a paper poster taped to the wall above the monitors
shots.action: hunching over a scratched keyboard, hammering keys fast

shots.narration: администратор выгонял его в шесть утра каждый день
shots.visual: the character stepping out of a basement door into grey early morning, empty courtyard of soviet apartment blocks, breath visible in cold air, backpack over one shoulder
shots.motion: static wide shot with a slight drift upward, breath and dust moving in the cold light
shots.action: shouldering the heavy door open and squinting at the daylight

shots.narration: он выигрывал так часто, что его считали читером
shots.visual: close angle on the character at a tournament table in a small local hall, a crowd of teenagers leaning in behind him, hostile faces, cheap fluorescent lighting, a plastic trophy on the table
shots.motion: slow lateral drift past the crowd, faces turning, fluorescent light buzzing
shots.brand_surface: a printed banner stretched across the wall behind the table
shots.action: leaning back from the table as the crowd presses in, jaw tight

shots.narration: его отстранили на два года и он почти ушёл
shots.visual: the character alone on a night bus, forehead against the dark window, empty seats, streetlights sliding past outside, reflection of his face in the glass
shots.motion: gentle handheld sway of the bus, streetlights sliding across the glass
shots.brand_surface: a small advertising sticker on the bus window frame
shots.action: pressing his forehead against the cold window glass, eyes closed

shots.narration: но он вернулся и переписал свою игру с нуля
shots.visual: cramped bedroom converted into a training setup, three monitors full of replays and notes, the character mid-session with headphones on, dawn light through the blinds, walls covered in handwritten diagrams
shots.motion: slow push-in toward the monitors, replay footage moving on screen, dust in the dawn light
shots.action: scribbling over a diagram, crossing lines out and redrawing them

shots.narration: через год он вышел на главную сцену континента
shots.visual: huge modern esports arena from the stage, the character small against a wall of light, thousands of phone flashes in the dark crowd, giant screens glowing above
shots.motion: slow rise revealing the crowd, phone lights twinkling, stage lights sweeping
shots.brand_surface: the giant LED banner above the stage
shots.action: raising one hand slowly to the roaring crowd

shots.narration: он не стал звездой, он стал системой
shots.visual: modern analyst room, the character standing calmly at a whiteboard covered in diagrams, a young team of players sitting and listening, warm evening light through floor to ceiling windows
shots.motion: slow lateral track past the seated players toward the character, evening light shifting
shots.brand_surface: team jerseys on the backs of the seated players
shots.action: sweeping a marker across the whiteboard mid-sentence

shots.narration: и теперь по его схемам играет весь регион
shots.visual: night city rooftop, the character standing at the railing with his back to camera, glowing skyline below, a wide dark sky above
shots.motion: slow push-in from behind, city lights flickering, clouds drifting
shots.brand_surface: an illuminated rooftop sign on a neighbouring building
shots.action: gripping the railing and leaning out over the drop
